capabilities: Save and name pasted or dropped images with configurable path templates and optional compression
Upload single or referenced images to Aliyun OSS, Qiniu, S3-compatible storage, or custom HTTP endpoints
Convert Wiki image references to standard Markdown across vault, folder, or note scopes
Browse and preview local and hosting images in a sidebar image browser
Detect and clean up orphan images and rename images while updating all references
extras: Docs cover known limitations in detail (one-way Wiki-to-Markdown conversion, custom HTTP hosting is upload-only, cross-hosting migration not implemented) and include provider-specific safety guidance such as least-privilege credentials and potential object-read charges.
problem: Obsidian only saves pasted images as attachments; it has no built-in tools for compressing images, uploading them to image hosting, rewriting references, or finding and cleaning up unused images.

requires.name: image hosting provider (Aliyun OSS, Qiniu, or S3-compatible) for upload and remote management features
provider credentials (access keys or tokens) for upload, listing, and delete operations

summary: Image management plugin that handles pasted images through naming, compression, hosting upload, reference updates, browsing, and guarded orphan cleanup.
